raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
Ministry: Ministry of Education
Department: Department of School Education & Literacy
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10, Class 11, Class 12
Academic Requirement: Minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class 7 (50% for SC/ST) to appear in the selection test (MAT/SAT) conducted in Class 8; continued clear progression for renewal.
School Type Requirement: Students studying as regular students in Government, Government-aided, or Local Body schools. (Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, and private residential schools are not eligible).
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 350000
Selection Mode: State-level competitive selection exam consisting of Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT).
Financial Assistance:  - Rs. 12000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10, Class 11, Class 12.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.
